en.title: lorlatinib: Highlights, Dosage and Administration, line "Renal Impairment" and 2.6 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: Highlights, Dosage and Administration, line "Renal Impairment" reads “75 mg orally once daily”. 2.6 reads “15 to < 30 mL/min”. Example: A patient with CLcr 60 mL/min gets the reduced dose by Highlights; by 2.6 and 8.7 no adjustment applies. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: low; careful reading of the whole label usually resolves it. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
